title: Unique Creamy German Paneer Casserole
description: A spicy and creamy German dish featuring paneer, this lacto-vegetarian friendly casserole is a light and delicious meal option. It combines the flavors of Germany with the creaminess of paneer.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large pan, saute the chopped onions and minced garlic until they are softened.
Add the sliced german sausage to the pan and cook until it is browned.
Add the canned tomatoes, vegetable broth, heavy cream, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Add the cubed paneer to the mixture and stir gently.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
